about_the_game:
Get ready for a high-stakes journey through the twilight in Echoes of the Night, a rhythm-action game inspired by Sayonara Wild Hearts. Set to the electrifying sounds of Barney & Company's debut album, this stylish adventure follows two master thieves on a collision course—both chasing the same score, both chasing something more.

With six dazzling levels, each pulsing to a track from No Refusal, you'll race, dodge, and fight through a heist gone beautifully wrong. Will they fall for each other or double-cross one another in a winner-takes-all showdown?

💠 Chapter 1 - Drove by a Pretty Place
Race through a breathtaking, European-inspired countryside as you dodge traffic and obstacles on your way to the grand castle—your heist begins here.

💠 Chapter 2 - Light It Up (Coming Soon)
Mingle among the elite at a lavish masquerade ball, stealing valuables without being caught. But beware—you're not the only phantom thief in the crowd.

💠 Chapter 3 - Liar (Coming Soon)
A dance-off like no other! Face off against your rival phantom thief in a rhythm-based showdown, hitting the right moves to outshine—or be outshined.

💠 Chapter 4 - Barney (Coming Soon)
The security is onto you! Navigate a sprawling castle maze, avoiding cameras and patrols as you make your daring escape.

💠 Chapter 5 - For What It's Worth (Coming Soon)
The grand finale—a high-speed chase atop a moving train! Time your jumps, dodge obstacles, and battle enemies in a climactic confrontation with your rival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R7 360, or Intel HD Graphics 630
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.4ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060, Radeon RX 5600 XT, or Intel Arc A580
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
